watches.name: Radcliffe INVERSEE
watches.description: So, what are we doing this time? NOT A WATCH BUT A PIECE OF MECHANICAL ART • ABSTRACT HOROLOGICAL ART: design something that was not seen EVER before, dare extreme choices & give a unique experience! • INNOVATION: pushing boundaries to achieve the FIRST EVER upside down wandering hour watch! +Have the watch case almost fully cased in box sapphire, top & bottom. • MODULAR CASE: also related to innovation, the case is said to be “MODULAR”, lugs and main case body are manufactured and finished separately, to achieve a high level of precision! And assembled together at the end, with one screw on each side • AFFORDABILITY: very technical and quirky high horology, made available on an average watch collecting budget……. • CONVERSATION STARTER: you will put to shame your table neighbour that is used to brag about his expensive watches lol….This watch will also attract the eyes of non watch people, whether it’s a date, at work, or a family dinner, you and your wrist will not remain invisible. Use this new superpower wisely :-D SPECIFICATIONS: • 12 months international warranty • 40mm diameter, 48mm lug to lug, 16mm • Unique way of reading the time! • Upside down wandering hours modified Miyota 8XXX series • Full stainless steel 316L and sapphire construction (no screws) • 360 open sapphire • Premium custom made leather straps • 3ATM • Mix of BGW9 and C3 Swiss super luminova DELIVERIES: The watches manufacturing process, and steps will be shared with the community. Deliveries around September 2024

watches.description: THIS IS A -LIMITED IN TIME EDITION- COLLAB BETWEEN RADCLIFFE & THE MAD WATCH COLLECTOR. THE M-DVR. PRE-ORDERS WILL OPEN FOR THREE WEEKS ONLY. A ONE OFF EDITION (WILL NEVER BE RE-ISSUED) Check Russel's presentation video here: https://youtu.be/Xpq5InKHynY?si=o5buCQ8X8faoUkhy Not just a diver! MUCH MUCH more! SPECIFICATIONS: 12 months international warranty 39 mm diameter, 43mm lug to lug, around 12 mm thickness Vintage inspired with a TWIST ;-) Modified true GMT Miyota 9075 movement, with colour changing indices (every hour) Full stainless steel 316L ,and box sapphire construction, ceramic bezel Premium tropical FKM rubber strap 200M water resistance Swiss superluminova DELIVERIES: The watches manufacturing process, and steps will be shared with the community. Deliveries around April 2026

watches.name: VIP LE DOME "TOURBILLON"
watches.description: Crystallised titanium with clear hour / minute domes also available now Now with a "tourbillon" complication!!!. A UNIQUE EXPERIENCE! Even more unique, the movement is a Radcliffe 476-1, entirely upgraded, new plates and rotor. In-house design enhanced by the community. The movement now has tourbillon and regulator modules. Le Dome is a unique concept at this pricepoint. It brings high horology to a much wider audience. It was featured on WATCHFINDER&CO, one of the biggest and most respected horology references. A detailed presentation of the watch can be found via our kickstarter project page https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radcliffe/radcliffe-le-dome-custom-complications-automatic-watch(https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radcliffe/radcliffe-le-dome-custom-complications-automatic-watch) SPECIFICATIONS: • 316L solid stainless steel construction • Double domed sapphire crystal showing an interesting and unique guilloché dial • CNC 5 axis machined, domed 3D subdials with BGW9 swiss superluminova • Raised & lumed Hour/Minute indicators with C3 swiss superluminova • Premium leather straps • 3ATM water resistance • 40mm case diameter, 48 lug to lug, 20mm lug width • Lots of fun! • 12 months international warranty • In-house movement modification and upgrade - Radcliffe 476 flying tourbillon movement with titanium top module (based on a japanese Miyota 8215) STRAPS: All straps delivered with the watches will be black. Extra fitted rubber in black or white are available. DELIVERIES: Deliveries will occur around end of September.

watches.name: Aluminium Lugs
watches.description: Designed to bring a new dimension to your Inversée, our Aluminium Lugs allow you to subtly transform the character of your watch. Originally offered during the Kickstarter campaign, these interchangeable aluminium lugs quickly became one of our most requested accessories. While some backers were able to secure them early on, many of you have been patiently waiting for a restock — and they are finally here. Machined from lightweight aluminium and anodised in carefully selected colours, these lugs offer a refined yet playful way to refresh your Inversée without changing the essence of the design. Whether you’re looking for a bold accent or a discreet colour contrast, they allow you to personalise your watch and adapt it to your mood or strap choice.

watches.name: L'INSTANT SONORE
watches.description: Not just another watch — RADCLIFFe timepieces are wearable mechanical art! Abstract Horological t(ch)ime Art: This is not your ordinary timepiece. We've dared to push boundaries again, creating a design never seen before. Experience a surreal, abstract interpretation of time — a true conversation starter that combines innovation with artistry. Revolutionary Innovation: with luxury features at this price point, it’s a bold statement in transparency and craftsmanship. An OPPORTUNITY to access High Horology: Combining complex mechanics and avant-garde design, this watch is crafted to be accessible — bringing cutting-edge craftsmanship within the reach of the average collector’s budget. Be the conversation Starter: Stand out wherever you wear it. Whether at a dinner, at work, or with friends, your wrist will be impossible to ignore — a symbol of daring design and technical mastery. SPECS: • Modified Miyota 9015 movement with regulator and chiming complications • Monopusher and visible column wheel for the chiming function ON/OFF • Flinqué (CNC + enamel dials) • Swiss superluminova • sapphire subdials • 316L steel case construction • 3ATM water resistance • bubble sapphire construction • 40mm diameter, 47 lug to lug • One year warranty DELIVERIES: The production process will be shared with the community through Whatsapp groups (you will be inviuted to join), and through our social media.

watches.name: BAUHAUS-ish AUTOMATIC
watches.description: Bauhaus-ish!! Minimalism meets primary color punch. Bauhaus-ish is what happens when clean, modern design grows a playful side. Inspired by the legendary Bauhaus movement but with a bold wink, this watch is built for those who like their wristwear with a little more personality. Every detail is intentional: • Bright blue dial for a calming canvas • Striking red and yellow hands that make timekeeping feel alive • A classic day-date window for everyday practicality • Rubber straps in unapologetic yellow and red — flipped for balance • Polished stainless steel case with a domed crystal that catches the light just right • A brushed caseback engraved bauhaus-ish — your subtle nod to design rebellion This watch doesn’t follow trends — it bends them. It’s not vintage. It’s not futuristic. It’s just… Bauhaus-ish. Designed for those who want to stand out, without shouting. Made in limited numbers. Worn by unlimited minds. SPECIFICATIONS: • 12 months international warranty • 38mm diameter, around 47mm lug to lug • Unique colourway! • AUTOMATIC day date modified Miyota 8205 series • Full stainless steel 316L and sapphire construction • Colourful FKM rubber straps • 10ATM • Lots of fun! DELIVERIES: The watches manufacturing process, and steps will be shared with the community. Deliveries around October 2025

watches.name: MAD WATCH COLLECTOR X RADCLIFFE field watch
watches.description: The M-HKR is arguably, the best affordable value for money field watch of 2024 . Influenced by military watches of the 1940’s , the M-HKR fuses those great traditional military specifications with robust modern technology to give you the confidence to wear and a pride of ownership . An unabashed, uncluttered tool timepiece in a very cluttered world. SPECIFICATIONS: • 316L solid stainless steel construction • Box sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating • Filled and printed swiss superluminova on the hands and dial • Premium military straps • 10ATM water resistance, with a scewdown crown construction • 36mm case diameter, 44 lug to lug, 18mm lug width, 9.5mm thick excluding box sapphire • Lots of fun! • 12 months international warranty • Premium Miyota 9039 movement modified into hand winding DELIVERIES: The watches manufacturing process, and steps will be shared with the community. Deliveries around June 2024
